about_the_game:
About This Game

Become a Psychic Envoy, dominate the scratch card board, and unlock a multiplayer gaming feast where strategy and luck intertwine.

Scratch & Nen is a casual competitive game that combines the fun of random scratch cards, strategic ability choices, and real-time multiplayer battles.

Duel on a mysterious 49-cell board where every scratch hides unknown surprises and crises, and every ability choice affects the team's situation.

No need to fight alone – you can compete online with three friends or match against players worldwide. Use abilities to interfere with opponents, seize opportunities to scratch and break the game, freely switch battle rhythms, and combine different ability styles to form exclusive strategies, becoming a feared psychic master on the board!

The board only submits to those who can balance luck, strategy, and team cooperation.

Flexibly use over 20 unique abilities to deal with randomly generated victory conditions and risky "Tribulation" cells. Adjust tactics based on each round's changes and teammate coordination to overcome seemingly impossible predicaments and forge your own scratch card competitive path.

Every match is unique – there's no fixed "winning formula." Only flexible adaptation and teammate collaboration can ensure victory.

Reasons You Can't Miss This Game

Rich Strategic Depth | 20+ unique abilities, random victory conditions, and crisis-hidden special cells – every move requires careful consideration.

High Match Freshness | Each round features different board layouts and victory goals, combined with elimination risks from "Tribulation" cells and player interactions, ensuring thrilling competitive fun every time.

Exclusive Multiplayer Mode | Supports up to 4 players in real-time online battles. Whether playing with friends or random matches, experience the joyful cooperation and competition of mutual restraint and speed judgment!

Beyond Traditional Scratch Games | Scratch & Nen combines strategic ability combinations, random board elements, and real-time multiplayer interactions, breaking the single-player limitation of traditional scratch games to deliver a brand-new casual competitive feast!

short_description: In Scratch&Nen, players compete on a 49-cell board(numbers,turn-wasting blanks,riskier elements). Each turn pick 1 of 20+ abilities, then scratch a cell. Random victory conditions—first to meet wins. Blends luck, strategy, intense elimination risks. Easy to learn in one round, supports max 4 players
